description: This file contains test helpers and mock setup functions for testing Matrix client resolution logic, including mock creation, configuration, and expectation functions.

methods.name: createMockMatrixClient
methods.description: Creates a mock implementation of the MatrixClient with stubbed methods for testing.

methods.name: primeMatrixClientResolverMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock return values and behaviors for matrix client resolution functions, returning a mock MatrixClient.

methods.name: expectOneOffSharedMatrixClient
methods.description: Asserts that a shared Matrix client was acquired and configured correctly during a test.

methods.name: expectExplicitMatrixClientConfig
methods.description: Verifies that the Matrix client configuration functions were called with expected parameters.
